channel.title: Shane's Daily Briefing (Private)
channel.description: A private daily news briefing: AI/Anthropic, world news, Ireland, Central Oregon, and sports (Man Utd, Seahawks). Not intended for public distribution.
channel.itunes:author: sgalligan

item.title: Daily Briefing — Saturday, November 14, 2026
item.description: Anthropic prices its IPO at $70-78 a share for a roughly $1.4 trillion valuation and a November 19th Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT; Salesforce keeps expanding Agentforce past 185,000 Coworker users; Congress remains without a funding deal as an FAA ground stop snarls Friday travel and the House sidesteps a Hegseth impeachment vote; Zelensky says the US has floated NATO membership for Ukraine over a Donbas withdrawal while Eisenkot works to form an Israeli government; Ireland's Budget 2027 tax cuts roll out; Bend heads into a chilly, showery weekend before a midweek warm-up; Manchester United turns to new head coach Mauricio Pochettino ahead of facing Liverpool on November 22nd; and the Seahawks, 5-4, travel to face the Raiders in Las Vegas.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Friday, November 13, 2026
item.description: Anthropic sets its IPO price range at $70-78 a share, targeting a valuation above $1.4 trillion with Nasdaq trading expected November 19th; Salesforce simplifies its 2026 editions and keeps expanding Agentforce as Coworker usage tops 185,000 users; the House stalls the Hegseth impeachment push by sending it to the Judiciary Committee as Nvidia's Jensen Huang review continues and forecasters watch another Northeast nor'easter; Israel's Eisenkot keeps working to form a government as the Dublin EU summit wraps up with Zelenskiy reporting progress on a prisoner exchange; Bend sees a breezy, showery start to the weekend; Manchester United sacks Michael Carrick and names Mauricio Pochettino as its new head coach ahead of facing Liverpool on November 22nd; and the Seahawks, 5-4 after beating the Cardinals, head to Las Vegas to face the Raiders.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Thursday, November 12, 2026
item.description: Anthropic launches its IPO roadshow days after unveiling Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2; Salesforce expands Agentforce with new job-ready AI agents and research-and-development agents that improve its own models; House Republicans block a surprise push to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth as Nvidia shares slide over CEO Jensen Huang's disclosed relationship; Israel's Eisenkot works to form a government as Netanyahu calls for unity; Irish unions strike a last-minute pay deal, averting a walkout as Dublin hosts the EU's European Political Community summit; Central Oregon's Silver Rail Elementary reopens after last month's shooting as county election results settle; Bend sees a mild, dry Thursday before weekend rain and wind; Man Utd fall to Roma in Europe but hold Aston Villa to a 4-4 draw ahead of hosting Liverpool; and the Seahawks improve to 5-4 after beating the Cardinals 17-3, with the Raiders up next.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Wednesday, November 11, 2026
item.description: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 with faster coding and reasoning as its international workforce triples; Salesforce's Agentforce Coworker usage grows 21x with new Teams, mobile, and desktop capabilities; Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff as the House moves toward impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth; Israel's president taps Gadi Eisenkot to try to form a government; Irish public sector unions strike November 12th against an EU summit in Dublin; Central Oregon has a quiet news day as new Deschutes County commissioners settle in; Bend sees a partly sunny, mild Wednesday before weekend storms; Man Utd draw 4-4 with Aston Villa and face Luton in the EFL Cup; and the Seahawks roll past the Cardinals 17-3 ahead of hosting the Raiders in Week 10.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Tuesday, November 10, 2026
item.description: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 while its AI for Science program and GSA government partnership keep expanding alongside its pending IPO; Salesforce's Agentforce Coworker usage grows 21x past 185,000 users with a new memory update and Koa Decisions; Congress returns to a funding fight as Democrats plan investigations and Trump backs Hegseth amid continued Strait of Hormuz tensions; Irish public sector unions lock in a second national strike for November 12th tied to an EU summit in Dublin; Central Oregon reacts to the Democratic sweep of the Deschutes County commission; Bend enjoys a dry, mild week before rain returns this weekend; Patrick Dorgu's late goal salvages a 4-4 draw for Man Utd against Aston Villa; and the Seahawks complete their season sweep of the Cardinals, 17-3.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Monday, November 9, 2026
item.description: Anthropic officially files its S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO and expands its GSA partnership to bring Claude, with a forty percent discount, to every level of government, while donating the Agent Skills standard to the new Agentic AI Foundation; Salesforce says Agentforce Coworker usage has soared twenty-one times over in three months past one hundred eighty-five thousand users and launches a new Koa Decisions product; Democrats weigh how to use their midterm sweep of Congress against Trump as U.S. strikes in the Strait of Hormuz and the Maduro situation keep Gulf tensions elevated; Irish public sector unions plan a second national strike for November twelfth timed to an EU summit in Dublin; Central Oregon digests the Democrat sweep of the Deschutes County commission as newly elected members prepare to take their seats; Bend sees light rain today with an above-normal pattern for the week; Patrick Dorgu rescues a late point as Manchester United and Aston Villa draw four-four; and the Seahawks beat the Cardinals seventeen-three to complete the season sweep.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Sunday, November 8, 2026
item.description: Anthropic's new Personal Finance feature lets Claude read bank and credit card transactions via Plaid to track spending and flag fees, even as investors reportedly push to trim the company's blockbuster IPO valuation toward one and a half trillion dollars after a tech stock selloff and the filing's own warnings about AI backlash; Salesforce lands a deal to help the UK's HMRC modernize tax services and rolls out new Agent Fabric governance guardrails for multi-vendor AI agents; Trump signals he's ready to battle a Democratic-controlled Congress after the midterm wipeout as Gulf tensions near the Strait of Hormuz simmer on; Irish unions and the government resume mediated talks over a pay dispute ahead of a November twelfth strike timed to an EU summit in Dublin; Democrats sweep every seat on Deschutes County's newly expanded Board of Commissioners; a mostly cloudy Sunday in Bend gives way to a damp Monday before Tuesday turns mostly sunny; Michael Carrick and Manchester United ease the pressure with a three-one win over Aston Villa; and the four-and-four Seahawks turn to Drew Lock at quarterback as they host Arizona and first-time starter Gardner Minshew.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Saturday, November 7, 2026

item.title: Daily Briefing — Friday, November 6, 2026

item.title: Daily Briefing — Wednesday, November 4, 2026
item.description: Anthropic's updated S-1 shows Q3 revenue hitting $17B even as compute costs balloon to 58% of revenue on pricey short-term neocloud contracts, while its safety team open-sources FlashProve, a tool to cryptographically verify which AI model generated a given reply; Salesforce agrees to buy voice-AI platform Cresta for about $2.7B, just weeks after its Braze deal, to plug a phone-call gap in Agentforce; Democrats sweep back control of the House and Senate in the midterms, flipping Texas, Ohio, Michigan and Kansas as Trump's approval sinks to a midterm-record-low 38%, while the US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island and Steve Witkoff preps new Ukraine-Russia talks; Ireland mourns Olympic runner Ciara Mageean as public sector unions call a November 12th strike; Central Oregon's election returns show Governor Kotek declaring victory over Drazan, Deschutes County electing Ty Rupert sheriff and Melanie Kebler keeping Bend's mayor's office; a mostly cloudy, freezing-foggy Wednesday in Bend gives way to a cooler, drier Thursday; Michael Carrick and Man Utd snap a nine-game winless run with a stunning 3-2 comeback over Roma ahead of Aston Villa; and the 4-4 Seahawks head to Washington for a Sunday night showdown.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Tuesday, November 3, 2026
